sols=[]
for names in itertools.product(transforms, repeat=4):
    if transforms[names[0]](*orig_marker['7'])!=(0,0): continue
    occ={}; ok=True; mapped=[]
    for name,piece,(ro,co),tn in zip(orig_order,[pieces[x] for x in orig_order],orig_offsets,names):
        f=transforms[tn]
        cells={(f(r,c)[0]+ro,f(r,c)[1]+co) for r,c in piece}
        if any(r<0 or r>=14 or c<0 or c>=14 for r,c in cells):ok=False; break
        if cells & set(occ): ok=False; break
        for rc in cells: occ[rc]=name
        mapped.append(cells)
    if ok:
        blanks={(r,c) for r in range(14) for c in range(14)}-set(occ)
        sols.append((names,blanks,occ))
len(sols), [(s[0],len(s[1]),s[1]) for s in sols[:20]]
